[[File:RoonTours.jpg|thumb|A Roon Tours cruiser in Mos Eisley]]
'''Roon Tours''' was a travel agency that gave wealthy, bitter tourists a thrill by taking them to out of the way, harsh [[Planet/Legends|planets]], such as those in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

There was a Roon Tours tourist center on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. A cruiser from this center was landing as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] came into [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to gain passage offworld.
